projects.name: DriVe2X
projects.role: Principal Investigator, Work Package Leader, UK pilot lead
projects.summary: Mass electric-vehicle deployment enabled by vehicle-to-everything (V2X): customer-centric local flexibility markets, grid-impact analysis and real-world pilot demonstration.
projects.note: Secured at Nottingham Trent, delivered there for two years, transferred to the University of Salford on 1 January 2025, where the majority of the technical development has taken place.

projects.name: NTU-GridLab
projects.summary: Laboratory developing open, data-driven tools for local communities, local flexibility market design, and TSO-DSO flexibility coordination.

projects.name: Active Building Centre Research Programme
projects.summary: Control and optimisation of distributed energy at building and network level.

projects.name: inteGRIDy
projects.summary: One of Europe's largest smart-distribution-grid projects, 30 partners. Built an Integrated Simulation Environment for planning and operation strategies.

projects.name: National Centre for Energy Systems Integration (CESI)
projects.summary: Defined vector-coupling storage based on power-to-gas, linking the gas and electricity networks to give system operators greater flexibility.

projects.name: Supergen Energy Networks Hub
projects.summary: Showed how power-to-gas as a vector-coupling technology can relieve heavily constrained electricity networks and improve whole-system efficiency.
